features.what: A setting shows attendee emails in the app only after their badge is scanned. Scanned visitor QR leads include team members, meeting leads go to the team members present, notes allow 500 characters and dashboards show companies.
features.detail: Attendee emails can be shown only after a badge scan. Scanned visitor QR codes include team members, lead contribution counts meeting appointments, notes have a character limit, and interaction dashboards show each participant's company.
stories: Changing badge display logic
Scanned Visitor QR includs also team members
Update Lead Contribution Logic for Exhibitors Based on Meeting Appointments
Lead capture notes field. Character limitation
Display  Company Name in Interaction Dashboards

features.title: Multilingual exhibitor manual documents
features.benefit: Give exhibitors the exhibitor manual document in their own language.
features.what: Organisers upload a separate file for each event language within one exhibitor manual document entry, and in Online Exhibitor Services exhibitors see only the file for their selected language.
features.detail: Organisers upload a separate file for each event language within one exhibitor manual entry, and exhibitors see only the file for their selected language.
stories: Exhibitor Tools: Organizer can upload Exhibitor Manual documents per Event language
Online Exhibitor Services-Frontend Experience / BE tbd after EP-49295

features.title: Random sponsor order and visibility
features.benefit: Rotate sponsors fairly and make sure sponsor names always show.
features.what: Sponsors and sponsored products can be shown in random order on the web and in the app, or by matchmaking score. The legacy view shows up to 150 sponsors, and sponsor names always appear on session cards and pages.
features.detail: Sponsors and sponsored products can be shown in random order on web and in the app, or by matchmaking score in the app. The legacy view shows up to 150 sponsors, sponsor names always appear on session cards and pages, and the custom sponsor limit has a tooltip.
stories: Random sorting for Sponsors and Sponsored products
Random sorting for sponsors in app
Increasing Sponsor Limit to 150 for legacy view
Session: Always display Sponsor Name on Session cards and pages
Add the tooltip for the Custom Sponsor limit field

features.title: Exhibitor insights portal
features.benefit: Exhibitors see the results of their event participation in one place.
features.what: The first page of the exhibitor insights portal shows leads captured, meetings held, profile views, message reply rate, best single day and a comparison with peers, all from the event's own data.
features.detail: The first insights page shows leads captured, meetings held, profile views, message reply rate, best single day and benchmarking against peers, based on real event data.
stories: Story 2: Page 01 — Celebrate your wins

features.title: Lead Capture Pro per team member
features.benefit: Turn lead capture and AI meeting notes on for individual team members, with unlimited questions for buyers.
features.what: The app applies lead capture and AI meeting notes access separately for each exhibitor owner and team member. Exhibitors who buy custom questions get unlimited standard and additional lead questions, with standard ones on.
features.detail: The app applies lead capture and AI meeting notes access per exhibitor owner and team member. Exhibitors who buy custom questions get unlimited standard and additional lead questions.
stories: Create Lead Capture Pro settings config for profile level
Lead Capture Pro – Full Access to Custom Questions

features.title: Region filters and brand import
features.benefit: Filter listings by region and keep exhibitors' brands when they join new events.
features.what: An optional Region filter under Country narrows exhibitor, product, brand, pavilion, delegate, speaker and buyer listings on the web. Exhibitor import and the global database attach existing brands, and logos can be allowed per category.
features.detail: An optional Region filter nested under Country narrows exhibitor and participant listings on web. Exhibitor import and adding from the global database attach an exhibitor's existing brands, and exhibitor settings include a logo option.
stories: Region filters
Enhancing Exhibitor Import to Attach Brands Across Events
Logo option as an exhibitor settings

features.title: Sponsored placements in global search
features.benefit: Sell sponsored banners, exhibitors and products on the global search page.
features.what: Global search shows one or two sponsorship banners plus rotating sponsored exhibitor and sponsored product blocks, with the organiser's labels and colours. Sponsor cards show location, tags and products, and multiple stands read clearly.
features.detail: Global search shows a sponsorship banner plus rotating sponsored exhibitor and sponsored product blocks with configurable labels and colours. Sponsor cards now show location, tags and products, and exhibitors with several stands display them clearly.

Global Search. Sponsored Exhibitors
